title: Breaking Language Barriers or Reinforcing Bias? A Study of Gender and Racial Disparities in Multilingual Contrastive Vision Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot templated image-text matching on the FAIRFACE and PATA datasets, calculating Max-Skew and symmetric KL-divergence to measure disparities in associating male versus female images with crime, communion, and agency stereotypes.

Zero-shot templated image-text matching on the FAIRFACE and PATA datasets, calculating the mean pairwise Max-Skew across different ethno-racial categories to measure disparities in crime, communion, and agency stereotypes.
